subject: Re: EVQA status: baseline at 44.1%, retrieval quality is the ceiling
body:
Team,

Decisions for the July 16 launch-review pre-read:

1. Product scope is single-hop only. Vera's 9% two-hop number settles it; we say so explicitly in the doc rather than letting the board discover it.
2. Headline metrics: 44.1% baseline, 61.7% oracle ceiling, and the distillation student at 91% teacher recovery at ~1/8 serving cost. That combination - a clear ceiling plus a deployable path - is the strongest story in the portfolio right now.
3. Entity-linking recall becomes the top Q3 investment; retrieval, not the reader, is where the next ten points live.

Kofi - the privacy/licensing review on the Wikipedia-derived KB kicked off June 24; can you confirm the 2-3 week SLA still holds so sign-off lands before the board date? That's the one open dependency.

Nadia, pre-read to you by EOD Monday.

Priya
